label: copy phase: fed-back x (late position) about to output r or x
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input is x (the model feeding back its own copied x). Every activation has in_tok = x. Within that, it is selective for the next output being r (75% of mass, the x-r bigram in the original) or x (21%, an xx bigram), and for x sitting at original position >= 3 (recall_idx >= 4). Activations are rare at recall_idx 3 and absent before that. It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter, even when x is followed by r there. Top activations are x->r at late positions, often in L=9 sequences. Magnitude is small (median 0.25) and many matching x->r steps stay silent with no history variable I found (digits, prev tokens, to_go) to separate them, so precision is only around 0.4. That suggests a near-threshold feature.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+4.42), in_tok=x (+3.55), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+3.55), out_tok=r (+3.31), next_out=r (+2.81), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+2.27).
